name: run_last_transcript_timestamp
notes: Last usable transcript timestamp (src/gateway/run.c::gw_last_transcript_timestamp vs LIVE gateway/run.py::_last_transcript_timestamp). Ladder: empty-history / per-row-from-end (usable-role check, meta/system skip, timestamp hit, legacy row without ts) / exhausted; -1.0 encodes LIVE None. Rows whose CONTENT text contains 'role'/'timestamp' substrings would confuse the port's raw strstr scan — such probes are excluded from the agreed sub-contract (documented C approximation). Non-dict JSON rows map to the no-usable-role rung on both sides.
